toolDescription: Sports-tuned web retrieval returning cleaned article text from fantasy, beat-writer, and odds sources. Call this for injury designations, practice reports, snap counts, depth charts, inactives, betting lines, and player news — it surfaces primary sources that general web search buries, and returns extracted body text rather than snippets. Use the built-in web_search for general reporting and web_fetch when you need to read one specific page end to end.

query.description: Search query. Include player name, team, and week or date when relevant — e.g. 'Bijan Robinson ankle practice report Week 5'.

recency_days.description: Only return results published within this many days. Use 2-3 for injury and inactive news, 7 for trend pieces, 30 for season-long analysis.
